result_text:
I fixed the typos in six default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `codeanalyzer` module tests pass. I didn't add tests for the new `.htm`, `<doc>` XML or `build-gradle.js` cases, so those aren't covered.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group `(html|html|xhtml)` is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match too. `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML:** the path pattern `.*/[.]xml` is now `.*[.]xml`, so a real `MyAssembly.xml` matches instead of only a file literally named `.xml`.
- **`// Generated by …` JavaScript:** the path pattern `.*/[.]js` is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The content patterns weren't touched, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files without the generator markers stay out of those scopes.
